verdicts.decision_note: The client establishes an original diagonal basket-weave print with an organic, textural, artisanal visual treatment.
The client accepts the proposed manual texture construction and production-ready seamless-repeat approach for the basket-weave artwork.
The client explicitly sets the weave diamond scale and mustard edge treatment rendered in the artwork.
First target-specific implementation claim: the freelancer reports delivering Basket Weave options in two texture treatments and two scales.
The client changes the implemented basket-weave diamond scale to the 7.5 cm option; the scheduling content is not encoded.
The client changes the artwork's contrast, grain, texture, edge finish, palette, rendering character, and diamond scale.
The client selects the named handcrafted 5 cm weave artwork and requires retention of detailing from the supplied reference.
The client changes the basket-weave artwork palette direction to match the original reference colour.
Target-specific implementation claim after the requested revisions: the freelancer provides Basket Weave artwork with the revised reference-based colour direction.
First concrete client verification after reviewing the revised artwork: the client approves the design direction for progression to final artwork.
The client explicitly changes the rendered Basket Weave border to a small mustard border.
The client replaces the border treatment with an explicit no-border design whose artwork extends to the edge; the negative treatment remains a meaningful current artwork rule.
Final target-specific implementation claim: the freelancer reports delivery of production-ready artwork, the Diagonal Basket Weave repeat tile, and documented final colour specifications.
